_comment: Acknowledged findings per checker. CI fails on any violation NOT listed
here (new instance of the class) and on any entry that no longer fires
(stale: the fix landed, so remove the entry in the same PR). Every entry
names its tracking reference: audit finding IDs are from the Sep/Nov 2026
CAM-SIMA audits, FG-n are that audit's fix groups. 'status' is one of:
bug (fix pending; entry must disappear with the fix PR), placeholder
(deliberate non-neutral value; entry stays until the registry schema can
declare it), triage (deliberateness not yet established; FG-1 sweep).

bcast:src/dynamics/se/dyn_comp.F90:se_dr.justification: real(r8) broadcast as one mpi_integer; non-master ranks keep uninitialized bytes. Fix: declare integer (XML and MPI already agree on integer).

nmlxml:se_dribble_in_rsplit_loop.justification: namelist XML type integer vs Fortran real(r8); same root cause as the bcast finding, both disappear with the same fix.

readnl:src/history/cam_hist_file.F90:his.justification: Read from hist_file_config_nl on the root task, never broadcast; non-root ranks keep the .false. default and pass it to config_set_up_hist_config, so interpolated output is configured on the root rank only. Fix: broadcast as MPI_LOGICAL alongside the other hist_file_config_nl broadcasts.
Interpolation grid size read on the root task, never broadcast; non-root ranks keep 0. Same fix as hist_interp_out (MPI_INTEGER).
Interpolation grid size read on the root task, never broadcast; non-root ranks keep 0. Same fix as hist_interp_out (MPI_INTEGER).

registry:tpert.justification: 273.15 K fallback reads as a +273 K parcel perturbation in ZM on step 0 of every default cam4 run; IC names also miss CAM's uppercase TPERT. Fix: initial value 0, add TPERT ic name.

registry:cldfrc.justification: 0.7 fallback runs ZM/Hack evaporation at 30 percent strength on step 0; IC name CLD misses CAM's CLOUD. Fix: initial value 0, add CLOUD ic name.

registry:sst.justification: cam_in surface placeholder before the first coupler import; non-neutral by design, hazardous only if exported/read before the import (F-ap_rad-1 class).

registry:ts.justification: cam_in surface placeholder before the first coupler import.

registry:tref.justification: cam_in surface placeholder before the first coupler import.

registry:tbot.justification: cam_out bottom-level placeholder before the first physics fill.

registry:thbot.justification: cam_out bottom-level placeholder before the first physics fill.

registry:pbot.justification: cam_out bottom-level placeholder before the first physics fill.

registry:psl.justification: cam_out sea-level-pressure placeholder before the first physics fill.

registry:rho.justification: cam_out bottom-level density placeholder before the first physics fill.

registry:ocnfrac.justification: cam_in ocean-fraction placeholder before the first coupler import.

registry:fv.justification: cam_in friction-velocity placeholder before the first coupler import.

registry:ram1.justification: cam_in aerodynamic-resistance placeholder before the first coupler import.

registry:qcwat.justification: -1.0 is an impossible-value sentinel by convention (cloud water content cannot be negative); undeclared convention, should become an explicit sentinel when the registry schema can say so.

registry:tcwat.justification: -1.0 impossible-value sentinel, same convention as qcwat.

registry:lcwat.justification: -1.0 impossible-value sentinel, same convention as qcwat.

registry:clubbtop.justification: 1.0 as a vertical-index placeholder (top of model) is plausibly deliberate; confirm a step-0 reader cannot mistake it for data before accepting permanently.

registry:relvar_in.justification: 2.0 is PUMAS's documented relative-variance default, plausibly a deliberate scientific fallback; confirm against CAM's phys_inidat seeding before accepting permanently.
